text: Figure 3.50: Example of a Phm monitoring and recovery setup The operation to be called by Phm in the context of [TPS_MANI_01280] and [TPS_MANI_03631] are defined in the Platform Health Management specification document [11]. As already mentioned, the State Management is supposed to implement the recovery actions. This implies that the PhmSupervisionRecoveryNotificationInterface and PhmHealthChannelRecoveryNotificationInterface can only be used in combination with a PPortPrototype. This aspect is clarified by [constr_1729].
